keySentence: He met a friendly Rat by the river.

facts.Page story text 1 (draft, teacher check: Mole and Rat talked by the river. Rat knew many things about the river. They rode in a boat together. He met a friendly Rat by the river.
facts.Page story text 2 (draft, teacher check: Mole and Rat sat together and talked for a long time. Rat told Mole about the wonderful life on the river. He met a friendly Rat by the river that sunny day. Rat showed Mole how to ride in a boat safely. The water sparkled and the wind blew gently. Mole felt happy to have found such a kind new friend.
